Natural Coir Doormat

Woven by hand from coconut coir, a by-product of the coconut industry. The doormat is 100% natural and fully biodegradable at the end of its life.

Backing: natural latex. Size 60 × 40 cm. Shake out dust weekly; do not machine wash.

Eco-friendly packaging: shipped in recycled kraft paper with no plastic tape.
